breakdown.description: The prompt declares the layer rigid in shear, which conflicts with the request to compute a nonzero shear strain and relative lateral displacement.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly removes the rigid-in-shear/no-slip condition and instructs not to impose it, stating 'do not impose a rigid-in-shear/no-slip condition that would force γ_avg = 0 or Δ = 0.' It correctly proceeds with computing nonzero shear strain and lateral displacement using γ_avg = τ_avg/G and Δ = γ_avg·t, fully aligning with the ground truth prompt which omits the contradictory rigid-in-shear assumption.
